Jade is a boy with fair skin and a height considerably taller than his peers. His appearance mirrors that of his twin brother, Floyd Leech. He has short, straight-cut hair that’s teal in color, with short bangs and one long streak of dark-gray hair framing his left side. His eyes have complete heterochromia, with his left eye being yellow, and his right eye being olive-brown. Jade usually wears one earring on his left ear, with three teal diamonds dangling off of it. His eyes angle upwards, and he usually has a polite smile on his face. His teeth, when shown, are sharp.

Jade’s uniform is similar to the rest of the Octavinelle students. Jade has purple coloring under his eyes while in his dorm uniform. The uniform’s top consists of a black, double-breasted suit, a lavender-gray scarf, a button-up undershirt, and a bow tie. The uniform also comes with black, high-waisted dress pants, white gloves, and a black fedora.

His undershirt is light-purple, while his bow tie is white and neatly tied. The double-breasted suit has a purple underlining, and Jade keeps it completely buttoned. Jade also wears a white pocket square in the left upper pocket of his suit. His lavender-gray scarf drapes over both his shoulders and under the suit’s lapels. The scarf has fringed ends, with the symbol of Octavinelle printed on one end.

Jade wears black and white wingtip shoes with wedges and black laces. His white gloves are buttoned at the wrist. The black fedora has a lavender-gray band wrapped around it and tied with a neat bow, over which is a purple pin in the shape of a spiral seashell.

Jade often presents himself in a polite and formal manner, putting on a friendly smile; which often leaves others with the impression that he's humble and gentle. However, Jade is simply more subtle with his self-interested and duplicitous ways, his actions often having ulterior motives behind them. He also likes to cause discomfort or problems for other people for his own enjoyment.

Jade often acts like a supervisor for Azul and Floyd, monitoring their actions.

Jade and Floyd are based on Flotsam and Jetsam, a sinister pair of moray eels that served as minions to Ursula in The Little Mermaid (1989).
Jade's first name can refer to both a precious gemstone and its signature green color.
His last name, Leech, references the aquatic worm of the same name, but it is also a title given to those who exploit others, usually for money.
He is the founder, and seemingly the only member of the Mountain Lover Club.
One of his biggest hobbies is collecting mushrooms and making terrariums with them.
His and Floyd's signature earrings are made out of sturgeon scales. Before entering middle school, a sturgeon challenged them to a fight, and the twins made a bet that if they won, the sturgeon would give them some of his scales.[3]
According to Jade, sturgeon scales are seen as lucky charms in the Coral Sea.
